Automation: Rules reference · play automation in progress

You turn through the surrounding blades, strike each opening in a single flowing sequence and step out before the circle closes.

Rules

Action
Main Action
Attribute
Agility
Target / range / shape
Up to three distinct adjacent enemies.
Duration
Damage and movement resolve immediately.
Equipment / acquisition
Requires a melee weapon; grants one ordinary melee weapon, Bulk 1, if absent.
Limits
Repeatable; normal action economy applies.
Type
Signature

Choose up to three distinct adjacent enemies and roll Agility once using the least favorable net Boons/Banes among them.

Weak
Deal 4 physical damage to each.
Standard
Deal 4 physical damage to each, then you may move up to 1 square without provoking.
Strong
Deal 6 physical damage to each, then you may move up to 2 squares without provoking.

This is one signature attack against all chosen targets. Choose all targets before rolling.

Additional rulings
